title: Biofilm mediated mineral alteration of limestone by Bacillus cereus and sulphate reducing bacterial consortia: impacts on quality grading, stability, and composition
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00841G, Paper
Yimtar L. Pongen, Balachandar Chinnappa, Saivenkatesh Kiran Bollapragreate, Parthipan Punniyakotti, Thirumurugan Durairaj
Microbial biofilms colonizing rock surfaces profoundly influence mineral composition, particularly in limestone, where they drive changes that compromise mineral quality and structure.
